title: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3

entities.name: Ruzi
entities.description: A Selesnya Wolf Rider who finds his sister's settlement slaughtered, kills Massacre Girl's ogre, and resolves to break from Selesnya to destroy Massacre Girl.

entities.name: Kuma
entities.description: Ruzi's wolf, who smells the blood, kills the ogre, and guards the baby Zi.

entities.name: Massacre Girl
entities.description: A skin-and-bones Rakdos killer for coin who leads the attack on Cecilee's settlement and taunts Ruzi.

entities.name: Rakdos ogre
entities.description: A nearly eight-foot-tall ogre in a dented mask armed with hooks and chains, who stays behind and is killed by Ruzi and Kuma.

entities.name: Cecilee
entities.description: Ruzi's sister, whose body he finds among the dead and buries.

entities.name: Zi
entities.description: Cecilee's adopted Gruul infant, found alive hidden in a cradle by Ruzi.

entities.name: Nikya of the Old Ways
entities.description: The Gruul leader of the Zhur-Taa clan, who listens to Ruzi and declares everyone loyal to the Rakdos demon guilty of a bloodcrime.

entities.name: Trostani
entities.description: The Selesnya guildmaster who would not permit a vengeance-killing by her guild.

entities.name: Rakdos Cult
entities.description: The guild of killers responsible for the massacre.

entities.name: Gruul
entities.description: The clans of the Rubblebelt who want the baby back and vow vengeance on the Rakdos.

entities.name: Zhur-Taa
entities.description: The Gruul clan led by Nikya, which worships ancient gods of old Ravnica.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: The guild of harmony that Ruzi decides to break from.

entities.name: Azorius
entities.description: The guild that would not arrest Massacre Girl for murders even of its own arrestors.

entities.name: Worldsoul
entities.description: The collective consciousness that Ruzi refuses to turn to for comfort.

entities.name: Selesnyan settlement
entities.description: Cecilee's walled community in the Rubblebelt, now strewn with bodies and marked with a Rakdos bloodmark.

entities.name: Rubblebelt
entities.description: The ruined region where the Gruul live.

events.summary: Kuma smells blood and carries Ruzi through the shattered gate into the settlement, surprising Massacre Girl and her men.
events.quote: The two surprised Massacre Girl and her men as they searched the bodies for anything valuable.

events.summary: Ruzi gutted the first cultist to attack and is surrounded, weakened by the fear that Cecilee is among the dead.
events.quote: Cecilee's body would be among the dead, and that knowledge made Ruzi weak.

events.summary: Massacre Girl refuses to say who hired her, taunts Ruzi, and leaves with her cultists, throwing confetti.
events.quote: Tossing it up into the air, she did a twisted bow and sashayed for the gate.

events.summary: Ruzi and Kuma dodge the ogre's chains and Kuma kills him by the throat.
events.quote: but the wolf's teeth closed around its throat before the ogre could raise its meaty arms to defend itself.

events.summary: Ruzi beheads the fallen ogre in a murderous rage.
events.quote: Feeling murderous, Ruzi sliced off the ogre's head while the it still lay blubbering on the ground.

events.summary: Ruzi buries the dead in a mass grave, including his sister, without looking at her.
events.quote: he couldn't bear to look at his sister—not even as he placed her body into the mass grave

events.summary: Ruzi resolves to break from Selesnya and make destroying Massacre Girl his purpose, knowing Trostani would not permit vengeance.
events.quote: If justice was to be done, Ruzi must break from Selesnya and find another way.

events.summary: Ruzi finds baby Zi alive in a hidden cradle and reasons the Rakdos were hired by someone from the city proper.
events.quote: Whoever hired Massacre Girl was someone from the city proper, someone who had coin to waste on murder.

events.summary: Ruzi meets Nikya of the Zhur-Taa clan and tells her his sister and the infant were murdered by Rakdos.
Nikya, convinced by the bloodwriting her scouts saw, declares everyone loyal to the Rakdos demon guilty of a bloodcrime against the Gruul.
events.quote: They will be slaughtered in the streets where they live.

events.summary: Ruzi rejoins Kuma, who guards the baby Zi, and vows to tear down the city.

relations.quote: My sister is dead, murdered in her home.
The baby—his nephew—quieted when he gently picked up him.
Only then did Kuma insist that Ruzi take a moment to grieve.

relations.note: She leads the cultists who attack the settlement.
relations.quote: Their skin-and-bones ringleader skulked outside the circle of her thugs

relations.note: A killer for coin called a Rakdos.
relations.quote: But it was carried about by a ringleader who calls herself Massacre Girl.
Nikya was the leader of the Zhur-Taa clan

relations.note: He and Kuma kill the ogre.
relations.quote: Ruzi sliced off the ogre's head while the it still lay blubbering on the ground.
he knew that destroying Massacre Girl must become his purpose in life.
